Changes may occur, there are still a few things I want to tweak! Bachelors and villagers will be done eventually. 

[size=4]Installation:
[/size]1) After downloading, drag the .xnb file(s) to ...\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
2) Doing this will replace the current .xnb for that character, it's a good idea to back up the default .xnb just in case you don't like the mod.
